scenarios.title: File a doctor call with promo, a colleague and a prescription
scenarios.description: The whole chain an MIO walks: window, territory, promo, colleagues, products, submit, then read it back from history and detail.

inputs.name: myEmpId

inputs.name: dcrDate
inputs.label: Call date
inputs.hint: must fall inside the window /config returned

inputs.name: rxImageBase64
inputs.label: Prescription photo (Base64)
inputs.hint: JPEG or PNG as Base64 (a data: prefix is fine). The default is a 1x1 PNG.

steps.title: My reporting window

steps.title: Areas and territories I cover

steps.title: Doctors and chambers from the existing sync
steps.note: DCR adds no doctor endpoint (B7a) - it reads the master the app already syncs at login. terrId comes from the chamber, so the promo list and the call always agree on the territory.

steps.title: Promotional stock for this territory and month
steps.note: Live stock for the call date month. An empty list is normal and must not block the call (B19).

steps.title: Colleagues I can name
steps.note: Both directions - managers above and officers below, minus me (B23/B24).

steps.title: Prescription products (any division)
steps.note: Every product; no division filter since 2026-10-01.

steps.title: Submit the call
steps.note: Promo is deducted in the same transaction as the call (B20).

steps.title: Read the call back
steps.note: Everything recorded should come back: promo with names, colleague with their real level (B25), products, and the submit GPS fix.

scenarios.title: The same doctor twice in one day is legitimate
scenarios.description: B2 removed the uniqueness rule, so a second identical call must save. The cost is that a double-tap on Submit files two and deducts promo twice - the app has to guard it, and only admin can delete the extra.

scenarios.title: Who is refused: no token, bad token, admin, another officer
scenarios.description: DCR runs its own field-role check against TERR_LIST rather than trusting the shared level helper, which returns MIO for anyone it cannot find (B6a). These are the cases that helper would have let through.
